decisions.reason: As a 2024 launch close to the established water-infrastructure offer and still shown on the website, it likely has enough technical and reputational commitment behind it that management would continue it unless early demand clearly disappoints.

The energy management system builds directly on the firm's software-engineering capabilities and announced strategic direction toward digitally networked, efficient infrastructure, so management is likely to defend and continue it.

Because this overflow flap gate is presented as a product line with several models on its own webpage, the firm has made the strongest visible commitment to it and would be especially reluctant to withdraw it so soon.
